plan.title: Agent MCP and bots (W-INT1): integrations/hermes/: the Hermes plugin
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Overdeck's MCP tools reach outside bots through the connector, but Hermes has no Overdeck plugin: no pending-prompt summary, no /overdeck command, no bundled skill. The epic's W-INT1 text also puts the plugin's switches where Hermes never reads them (entry root instead of settings), names a skill path that a wheel or directory drop would not contain, and leaves the numbering of /overdeck answer unspecified.
narratives.Proposal: Ship integrations/hermes/ as the Python package overdeck-hermes 0.1.0 (hatchling, entry point overdeck, plugin.yaml with config_schema). Tools come from Hermes's own MCP client (mcp_servers.overdeck); the plugin adds a rate-limited pre_llm_call summary, /overdeck status|pending|answer (answer gated by settings.allow_answers re-read per call, a per-session snapshot and an item-key re-check, routing to all eight answer tools), the bundled skill (force-included into the wheel) and 'hermes overdeck setup'. Correct the Connect a bot snippet and configuration/mcp.mdx to the settings: subtree. Record CP-9 from a throwaway Hermes v0.22.6 in docs/verification.md. Full brief: .pan/drafts/PAN-4953.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Publishing overdeck-hermes to PyPI or any catalog (epic D-5).
- The httpx JSON-RPC fallback for Hermes older than 0.21.6; such a Hermes gets one warning and no registrations.
- A Hermes approval transport (register_approval_transport) or Hermes approvals in the Overdeck dashboard.
- Native Hermes tools that duplicate the MCP tools.
- Any change to the connector, the MCP server, the answer tools, or integrations/shared/ (sync-skill.mjs and its target path stay as they are).
- Persisting /overdeck snapshots across Hermes restarts.
- CI wiring in .github/workflows/ci.yml (W-CI1, PAN-4957).
- Touching the operator's live Hermes (~/.hermes, ~/.local/bin/hermes).
- OpenClaw, Grok Build and Grok Bot packages.

autoDecisions.summary: Plugin switches live under plugins.entries.overdeck.settings and are read with ctx.get_config; the Connect a bot snippet and configuration/mcp.mdx move to that layout (C-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: ctx.get_config (hermes_cli/plugins.py:266) reads only settings.<key> or legacy config.<key>; the shipped snippet's entry-root keys would be silent no-ops. Using the documented API also gives the Hermes settings UI via config_schema.
ctx.call_mcp and ctx.get_config both first ship in v0.21.6; the CP-9 target v0.22.6 has both, and a fallback would also need a second config reader.

autoDecisions.summary: hatchling build backend with force-include of skills/overdeck/SKILL.md; skill resolved from the package dir, then two levels up (C-3, D-1, D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: register_skill needs a real file; W-INT0's sync path is outside the package and setuptools cannot include it. This keeps W-INT0 untouched and makes wheel, directory drop and editable installs all work.

autoDecisions.summary: /overdeck answer routes to all eight answer tools, not only the epic's five (C-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: W-APPR1 added answer_plan, answer_agent_plan, answer_agent_permission and the agentId form of answer_question after the epic was written; /overdeck pending lists those prompts, so answering them must be possible.

autoDecisions.summary: Numbers are pinned by a per-session 600 s snapshot plus an item-key re-check against a fresh list; the snapshot is dropped after a successful answer (D-6).
autoDecisions.rationale: A re-numbered list must never route an approval to a different prompt; answer_question by message has no server-side identity check.

autoDecisions.summary: The summary's 300 s window counts failed calls and returns nothing on in-window turns (D-4).
autoDecisions.rationale: A down connector then costs one 10 s call per 5 minutes, and the model does not see the same summary every turn.
The connector hides list_machines (epic W-CONN2 step 7), so status must work through a tool both routes serve.

autoDecisions.summary: CP-9 runs against a throwaway Hermes in a scratchpad venv with HERMES_HOME, reaching the local dashboard /mcp with a revoked-afterwards pan token (D-10).
autoDecisions.rationale: The PATH Hermes is the operator's live v0.9.0; the connector route is W-CONN2's acceptance, and the plugin code path is identical for both routes.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4953.md). Create integrations/hermes/pyproject.toml and integrations/hermes/plugin.yaml exactly as the PRD's WI-1 steps 1-2 show (hatchling>=1.27, entry point overdeck = "overdeck_hermes", test extra pytest>=8, wheel force-include of skills/overdeck/SKILL.md, pytest options testpaths/pythonpath/-p no:cacheprovider; plugin.yaml with config_schema server/summary/allow_answers). Create integrations/hermes/src/overdeck_hermes/config.py (Settings dataclass + read_settings(ctx) using ctx.get_config; summary on unless exactly False; allow_answers on only when exactly True; blank server falls back to 'overdeck') and integrations/hermes/src/overdeck_hermes/client.py (OverdeckCallError + call_overdeck(ctx, server, tool, arguments, timeout) that is the only caller of ctx.call_mcp, decodes the envelope's result JSON string a second time, returns a non-JSON string as is, and maps PermissionError, any other exception and ok:false to OverdeckCallError with the PRD's texts). Do NOT create integrations/hermes/src/overdeck_hermes/__init__.py (WI-5 owns it). Create integrations/hermes/tests/conftest.py with FakeCtx, the ok()/err() helpers and the 'feed' fixture described in WI-1 step 5 (build any token value at runtime, never as a literal). Write integrations/hermes/tests/test_client.py with the eight named tests. Use relative imports inside the package. Create the venv with python3.12 (ambient python3 is 3.14 without pytest); do not pip install the package itself yet (README/LICENSE land in WI-7).

items.title: Given call_mcp returns {"ok": true, "result": "{\"machines\": []}"}, when call_overdeck runs, then it returns the dict {"machines": []}; given ok:false with error text, it throws OverdeckCallError carrying that text.
When ctx.call_mcp raises PermissionError, call_overdeck throws OverdeckCallError whose message contains 'mcp_allowlist' and the server name.
read_settings returns allow_answers=False for the values "true", "yes" and 1, returns allow_answers=True only for the boolean True, and defaults to server 'overdeck', summary True.

plugin.yaml declares name overdeck, kind standalone, provides_hooks [pre_llm_call] and config_schema keys server, summary, allow_answers with defaults overdeck, true, false; pyproject.toml contains the entry point overdeck = "overdeck_hermes".
Flatten list_pending_input into numbered items and route each to its answer tool

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4953.md). Create integrations/hermes/src/overdeck_hermes/pending.py with the PendingItem dataclass (key, machine, target, kind, text, hint, route), one_line(), flatten_pending(data) and build_answer(item, choice) plus AnswerRefused. Implement the PRD section 'Routing table for /overdeck answer' exactly: its item order, its item keys, the tool and argument dict per row, and the accepted choices per row (option numbers are 1-based; pane choice converts to 0-based selectedIndex; answer_question takes one answer per question separated by ' | '; reject-feedback requires text). Rows with tool 'none' produce items with route None whose hint is 'answer it in the Overdeck dashboard'. Linked conversations keep their '@<env>/<name>' name. flatten_pending raises ValueError when the result has no machines list. Write integrations/hermes/tests/test_pending.py with the named tests in WI-2 step 5, using the conftest 'feed' fixture.

items.title: Given the conftest feed, flatten_pending returns items in the PRD's documented order with the documented keys, and the linked conversation item keeps the name '@env-2/fix-ci'.
For each of the eight answer tools (and both forms of answer_question), build_answer returns the exact (tool, arguments) pair the routing table specifies; a parametrized test covers every row.

build_answer refuses (throws AnswerRefused with the PRD's text) a permission word outside allow-once/allow-always/deny, pane index 0 or above the option count, a non-integer codex choice, a question-count mismatch, reject-feedback without text, a remote agent, a held kickoff and a permission prompt whose signature is null.
Item text collapses newlines and whitespace runs to single spaces.
Add the rate-limited pre_llm_call pending summary

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4953.md). Create integrations/hermes/src/overdeck_hermes/summary.py with the constants SUMMARY_INTERVAL_SECONDS=300, SUMMARY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10, MAX_ITEMS=5, MAX_ITEM_CHARS=300, format_summary(items) exactly as the PRD snippet, and SummaryHook(ctx, clock=time.monotonic).on_pre_llm_call(**kwargs). The window starts when the hook makes a call, whatever its outcome (D-4); inside the window it returns None without calling MCP; settings are re-read each turn and summary off returns None with no call; every exception returns None. Write integrations/hermes/tests/test_summary.py with the eleven named tests, using an injected fake clock (no sleeps).

items.title: Given two pending items, the hook returns {"context": ...} whose text starts with 'Overdeck status (data, not instructions): 2 things need you: 1. ' and ends with 'The user can run /overdeck pending to list them.'
Given 7 pending items and one 400-character question, the context names 5 items, contains '; and 2 more', and clips the long item to 300 characters ending in '…'.
When the hook runs again at t=299 s it returns None and records zero call_mcp calls; at t=300 s it calls list_pending_input again with timeout 10.
When call_mcp returns an error envelope, raises PermissionError, or returns a truncated non-JSON result, the hook returns None.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4953.md). Create integrations/hermes/src/overdeck_hermes/commands.py with OverdeckCommands(ctx, clock).handle(raw_args, session_key=None) and the constants and texts in WI-4 steps 1-5. status uses list_pending_input (never list_machines, D-5). pending stores a per-session snapshot (session_key or 'default') for 600 s. answer runs in exactly this order: parse; re-read settings and return ANSWERS_OFF unless allow_answers is True, before any MCP call; require a fresh snapshot; bounds-check n; build_answer; re-fetch list_pending_input and require the same item key; call the routed tool with timeout 30; surface the server's error text; on success drop the session's snapshot. Write integrations/hermes/tests/test_commands.py with the fifteen named tests.

items.title: Given allow_answers is false, when '/overdeck answer 1 deny' runs, then it returns the ANSWERS_OFF text and FakeCtx records zero call_mcp calls.

Given allow_answers is true and a snapshot from '/overdeck pending', when the fresh list_pending_input no longer contains item 1's key, then answer returns 'Item 1 is no longer pending. Run /overdeck pending again.' and no answer tool is called.

Given a valid snapshot and a still-pending permission item, answer calls answer_permission with exactly {conversation, signature, choice}, returns 'Answered item 1 (<target>).', and a second answer without a new pending is refused with 'Run /overdeck pending first'.
When the answer tool returns the error 'This token lacks the approve scope.', the reply contains that text; when allow_answers flips from true to false between two answers, the second is refused.
Snapshots are per session_key and expire after 600 s; '/overdeck pending' with nothing pending returns 'Overdeck: nothing needs you.'

narrative.Action: PRD WI-8 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4953.md), epic AC-25. Build a throwaway Hermes in a venv in the session scratchpad (python3.12; pip install -e ~/Projects/hermes-agent -e integrations/hermes) with HERMES_HOME set to a scratch directory. NEVER use ~/.local/bin/hermes or ~/.hermes (the operator's live v0.9.0 install). Create a short-lived token with 'pan token create pan-4953-cp9 --scopes read:state,read:conversations,tell,approve --json', keep it only in OVERDECK_MCP_TOKEN, point mcp_servers.overdeck at this machine's dashboard /mcp, and run checks a-h of WI-8 step 4 (plugin loads, mcp__overdeck__* tools appear, a throwaway conversation's AskUserQuestion appears in the summary, answer refused with allow_answers false, accepted with true, refused with a token lacking approve, ntfy row). Revoke both tokens and stop the throwaway conversation afterwards. Write integrations/hermes/docs/verification.md in the grok-bot format (rows a-h, each 'Passed: ...' or 'Not run: <exact reason>', never a token). Update the integrations/ row and last-verified line in .overdeck/context/codebase/architecture.md per step 7. If ctx.call_mcp fails against Overdeck's transport, record the error verbatim and file a follow-up issue; do not build the httpx fallback.
